newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 3.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Assembly president Charles Donwani opens parliamentary session: stresses need for measures to check insecurity and corruption in Ivory Coast
- Accord signed for Anglo-French engineering firm GEC-Alsthom to be represented in Ivory Coast by local diversified group SIFCOM.
- Construction of regional wholesale market for foodstuffs begins in central Ivorian town of Bouake; project cost of 13 billion CFA francs to be partly financed by European Union.
- Seminar conclusions stress need for cooperation between commercial banks, insurance companies and mutual funds.
- Magistrates' association says draft legal reform law threatens independence of the judiciary.
